evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jules: 'This should take me about five to ten minutes or so and then I'll get you an accurate quote. Does that sound good to you?' — framing present but rep doesn't cleanly wait for the yes; customer says 'Okay, say that again' and Jules rephrases as 'Awesome, does that work for you? Do you have time right now?' without returning to the original promise structure.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Samantha Babicky), moving day (Monday or Tuesday next week), city-to-city (storage to business, 6819 Hillcrest), approximate size (7x10 storage unit). All four covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep jumps straight into 'Do you already have a date' without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (storage unit), floor/stories (fourth floor storage, ground floor destination), number of rooms (N/A — storage/business), walking distance (5 miles mentioned), additional rooms (not applicable), special considerations (heavy dresser, no boxes, 10 pieces furniture), additional stops (none). Parking situation extensively probed: 'Anything to note about the parking situation in either locations. Anything that would make it hard for 26 foot box truck to park in.' Customer provides detailed parking instructions.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. Rep mentions wrapping furniture 'And if they're currently not wrapped, we can wrap them and moving blankets' as part of the rate, but never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. No mention of box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given and personalized: 'for this move I would just budget anywhere from the minimum of two and a half to three hours at most. So anywhere from $510 to $612.' Anchored to the specific job (small storage, 10 pieces furniture, ground-floor destination, minimal complexity).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Hourly rate structure disclosed upfront: '$204 per hour for two movers and one truck. That hourly rate includes everything. You know the gas truck taxes and insurance.' Minimum and proration explained: 'we have a minimum of two and a half hours and then after that we prorate every fifteen minutes.' No trip fee or overnight fee mentioned (N/A for this move type), and the 'not a guess' commitment framing is present in the rate structure explanation.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not explicitly asked. After the estimate, customer immediately says 'Okay, that sounds reasonable, I'd like to go ahead and book it.' Rep does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent, though customer volunteered acceptance.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. The Two Promises section is entirely skipped.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep moves directly to booking confirmation without any 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or 'any questions?' check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' variant.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Customer volunteers 'I'd like to go ahead and book it' after the estimate, but rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' The booking happens on the customer's initiative, not from a rep ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Date/time confirmed (Monday, 8:30–9 a.m.), phone not confirmed, arrival window understood but not explicitly locked, crew size not mentioned, destination address confirmed (6819 Hillcrest), storage address confirmed (903 Slocum). Parking notes made ('I'll make a note of that'), but no explicit crew notes summary or final recap of customer's concerns/priorities.

top_strength: Jules expertly probed the parking and access logistics for both locations, gathering detailed, actionable notes (narrow alleyway, dry cleaners, recommended back-in approach) that protect the move's success and demonstrate attentiveness to customer constraints.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) and Section 5 (Two Promises) were completely skipped — ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' early, and always deliver the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage before closing, regardless of whether the customer volunteers a booking.
booking_note: Customer explicitly stated 'I'd like to go ahead and book it' and agreed to the Monday 8:30-9:00 AM time slot, which was confirmed by the agent.
